lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: This is going to sound ridiculous, but I put a practice match on my rehearsal calendar.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: She asked if it was a new song. I said no. The drummer offered to test my deck after soundcheck anyway.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I've got two openings I can't decide between. Would you play a few hands with me sometime?

choices.label: I'd love to. You pick the table.
choices.reply: Yes! And bring that awful disruption deck. I need the practice.

choices.label: I can't make it this week.
choices.reply: Okay! Send me a message when you've got an evening free.
